args.summary: One laptop (FX-BATT-01, hostname fx-macbook-batt) needs a battery replacement: its battery condition is "Service Recommended" since 2026-06-07 with a cycle count of 993. One other device had too few snapshots for a trend assessment, but its latest snapshot was checked.

claims.text: Laptop FX-BATT-01 (fx-macbook-batt) has a battery condition of "Service Recommended" since 2026-06-07, indicating it needs replacement.
The same laptop shows a 7.6% decline in full-charge capacity over the telemetry window (5760 → 5320 mAh), an early sign of battery wear.
One device had insufficient snapshots (fewer than 7) for a battery trend assessment, though its latest snapshot was still evaluated.

caveats: Design capacity is not in the data, so the capacity decline is a relative measure, not a battery health percentage.
Telemetry covers 2026-05-20 to 2026-06-12 only; devices not seen in this window are not represented.
